events.text: Not to much to focus on other than the crypto market taking a beating. sol has dropped considerably. It very much feels to me as large scale market manipulation. And that’s something we can’t control, so when people are being fearful, that’s your time to be greedy, with all of your investments. Focus on cost averaging. Fill your bags. We had an influencer mention Cino in one of his posts, I shared that. Hopefully that brings traction. If you see it, share with our website to get people looking. You tube subscribers are rising nicely and we had a great video last week. We hope to keep increasing our exposure and gain new investors. Tik tok followers broke the 20k mark and increasing daily. Business at rams is increasing over the last few months, so hopefully we can get some operators to start using Cino, and it just seems like they haven’t done it because they are just busy and “business as usual”. We are going to put out some training a on how to implement crypto into normal business accounting soon. Maybe that will help the accounts payable people adopt it easier. Have a great week and stay tuned for more updates. We are going non stop. Tomorrow we will be having another session with the app developers. Thank out for your support. Rc

events.text: So the crypto markets have been shit….but they will recover. That being said, I have been doing a lot of thinking lately about the corporate adoption struggles. If I can get all the features out of the app that I want it will be a one stop shop for all things CINO. I will post more about this soon. Stay tuned for our new content, we have a guest tonight which should be great. Invest in yourself. Plan for your and your families future. Generational wealth. Cost average. Thanks for your support. events.author: CINOtoken
events.text: I’ve been in contact with the fbi’s ic3 department and a company called zero shadow. They provide an in depth investigation and assist law enforcement. I’m still at a loss. I can’t comprehend how my machine got compromised. The support team at phantom stated that my pc has interacted with a malicious website and they have blocked the site entirely. I’ve never heard of the website and feel like I take every precaution possible when it comes to internet security. I’m sick over this event. I feel absolutely terrible for all of us. We have been working our asses off to make this work and this is a huge kick in the shorts. Right now I feel defeated. I feel my breath has been knocked out of me. I promise you i will stand up and continue to work on this project. I will continue to push for success. I will not quit. If you know anyone who can help us track down an ip address, a location, any bit of information, I would greatly appreciate some contact information. I know it’s a long shot but we have to try. Thank you for support. Rc
